summary: Ecopetrol S.A. furnished a Form 6-K reporting the Board of Directors' September 17, 2026 decisions: election of Carlos Augusto Suárez Rojas as Board Chairman and Claudia Margarita Lafaurie Taboada as Vice Chair, plus composition of six supporting committees, effective immediately, with thanks to outgoing Chairman Luis Felipe Henao Cardona. The filing also recites Ecopetrol's profile, including its 51.4% ISA stake. No transaction terms, advisors or board recommendations on any deal are stated. This is a routine board-governance announcement rather than a forced CEO/CFO departure; watch for any subsequent senior executive changes or strategic shifts under new leadership.
